evidence.quote: enrolls its creator as a reviewer

observations.why: The assertion enacts a governance rule: saving a memory assigns the relational role of reviewer to the creator — an authority-ranking allocation of a position by the system's rule.

evidence.quote: This probe memory exists only to carry that assertion

observations.why: The speaker frames the memory as an instrument whose sole purpose is to carry the enrollment rule, reinforcing the authority-ranking allocation by subordinating the utterance to that governance act.
